# `auth.token.create`

Mint a scoped agent token

Session-only with fresh auth. The secret is shown once. A repo selector narrows the token to listed repositories.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/tokens`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth token create`
- MCP: `auth_token_create`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `name` | body | no | `string` |
| `repos` | body | no | `value` |
| `scopes` | body | yes | `string` |
| `ttl` | body | no | `string` |

## Errors

`not-found`, `unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
